#Merge slides if needed 
```{r}
#in cell profiler images were cropped to avoid blurry edges
#nuclei and perinuclei segemnted
#inetnsities measured
cell_profiler_process_path <- "/Users/kristineccles/SynologyDrive/CPImages/Staining/Hepatocytes D21/output/"

merge_data <- function(cell_profiler_process_path, slide = NULL) {
  
  # Automatically detect plate folders
  if (is.null(slide)) {
    slide <- list.dirs(cell_profiler_process_path,
                        recursive = FALSE,
                        full.names = FALSE)
    slide <- slide[str_detect(slide, "^Slide")]
  }
  
  add_suffix <- function(df, suffix, key_cols) {
    non_key <- setdiff(names(df), key_cols)
    rename_with(df, ~ paste0(.x, suffix), all_of(non_key))
  }
  
  merge_slide <- function(slide_dir, slide_name) {
    
    Nuclei     <- read_csv(file.path(slide_dir, "Nuclei.csv"),     show_col_types = FALSE)
    Perinuclei <- read_csv(file.path(slide_dir, "Perinuclei.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
    
    key_cols <- names(Nuclei)[1:7]
    
    Nuclei     <- add_suffix(Nuclei,     "_nuclei",     key_cols)
    Perinuclei <- add_suffix(Perinuclei, "_perinuclei", key_cols)
    
    join_keys <- Reduce(intersect,
                        list(names(Nuclei), names(Perinuclei)))
    
    Nuclei %>%
      full_join(Perinuclei, by = join_keys)
  }
  
  map_dfr(slide, function(slide) {
    slide_dir <- file.path(cell_profiler_process_path, slide)
    message("Reading: ", slide_dir)
    merge_slide(slide_dir, slide_name = slide)
  })
}

all_data <- merge_data(cell_profiler_process_path)
```

#Find thresholds
```{r}
all_data <- all_data %>%
  mutate(
  
    HNFa4_ratio = Intensity_MedianIntensity_CHNFa4_nuclei /
                  (Intensity_MedianIntensity_CHNFa4_perinuclei)
  )

hist(all_data$HNFa4_ratio, breaks = 10)

#greater than 1 = pos
all_data <- all_data %>%
  mutate(
    HNFa4_status = ifelse(is.na(HNFa4_ratio) | HNFa4_ratio <= 1, "HNFa4_neg", "HNFa4_pos") #i checked some status is NA become NHFa4 median intensity is 0 i set to negative
  )

hist <- all_data %>%
  select(
    Metadata_slide,
    Metadata_coverslip,
    Metadata_sex,
    HNFa4  = Intensity_MedianIntensity_CHNFa4_nuclei,
    ALB    = Intensity_MedianIntensity_CAlbumin_perinuclei,
    AFP    = Intensity_MedianIntensity_CAFP_perinuclei,
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
     cols      = -c(Metadata_slide, Metadata_sex, Metadata_coverslip),  # pivot everything except the slide column
    names_to  = "marker",
    values_to = "intensity"
  )
ggplot(hist, aes(x = intensity, fill = marker, color = marker)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.3) +
  facet_grid(marker ~ Metadata_slide + Metadata_sex , 
             scales = "free") +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(x = "Mean Intensity", y = "Density", 
       title = "Per-slide intensity thresholds") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

#set threshols
ALB <- 0.25
AFP <- 0.25
```

#Classify cells
```{r}
# Classify cells
all_data_classified <- all_data %>%
  mutate(
    HNFa4_pos = HNFa4_status == "HNFa4_pos",
    ALB_pos   = Intensity_MedianIntensity_CAlbumin_perinuclei > ALB,
    AFP_pos   = Intensity_MedianIntensity_CAFP_perinuclei > AFP,
    # Detailed phenotype (
  hepatic_class = case_when(
    # HNF4+ branch (primary biology)
      HNFa4_pos &  ALB_pos & !AFP_pos ~ "Mature hepatocyte",
      HNFa4_pos &  ALB_pos &  AFP_pos ~ "Immature hepatocyte",
      HNFa4_pos & !ALB_pos &  AFP_pos ~ "Hepatoblast",
      HNFa4_pos & !ALB_pos & !AFP_pos ~ "HNF4+/ALB-/AFP-",

      # HNF4- branch
    !HNFa4_pos & !ALB_pos & !AFP_pos ~ "Non-hepatic",
    !HNFa4_pos ~ "HNF4- hepatocyte",
)) %>%
select(1:7,
         Intensity_MedianIntensity_CHNFa4_nuclei,
         Intensity_MedianIntensity_CAlbumin_perinuclei,
         Intensity_MedianIntensity_CAFP_perinuclei,
         HNFa4_pos, ALB_pos, AFP_pos,
         hepatic_class)
```


#Plot Hepatic class
```{r}
custom_colors <- c("#330597", "#5c01a6", "#9c179e","#cc4778", "#ed7953", "#fdb42f","black" )
shape_map <- c('female' = 24, 'male' = 21)
# Summarize phenotype frequencies
hepatic_class <- all_data_classified %>%
  
  # Step 1: percent per image (within each slide)
  group_by(Metadata_slide, Metadata_sex, Metadata_image, hepatic_class) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(Metadata_slide, Metadata_sex, Metadata_image) %>%
  mutate(percent = 100 * n / sum(n)) %>%
  
  # Step 2: collapse images → slide, sd/se are across images within a slide
  group_by(Metadata_slide, Metadata_sex, hepatic_class) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_percent = mean(percent, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd           = sd(percent, na.rm = TRUE),
    n            = n(),        # number of images per slide
    .groups      = "drop"
  ) %>%
   # Step 3: collapse slides → sex, sd/se now across slides
  group_by(Metadata_sex, hepatic_class) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_percent = mean(mean_percent, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd           = sd(mean_percent, na.rm = TRUE),
    n            = n(),        # number of slides per sex
    .groups      = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(se = sd / sqrt(n))


hepatic_class$hepatic_class <- factor(hepatic_class$hepatic_class, levels = c(
  "HNF4+/ALB-/AFP-",
  "Hepatoblast",
  "Immature hepatocyte",
  "Mature hepatocyte",
  "HNF4- hepatocyte",
  "Non-hepatic"
))

hepatic_summary <- hepatic_class %>%
  group_by(hepatic_class) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_percent = mean(mean_percent, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

p <- ggplot(hepatic_class,
       aes(x = hepatic_class,
           y = mean_percent,
           color = factor(hepatic_class))) +
  
  geom_col(
    aes(fill = factor(hepatic_class)),
    alpha = 0.15,
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.7),
    width = 0.6,
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    # need x and y too since inherit.aes = FALSE
    data = hepatic_summary,
    mapping = aes(x = hepatic_class,
                  y = mean_percent,
                  fill = factor(hepatic_class))
  ) +
  
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = mean_percent - se,
        ymax = mean_percent + se),
    width = 0.2,
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.7)
  ) +
  
  geom_jitter(
    aes(fill = factor(hepatic_class), shape = Metadata_sex),

    alpha = 0.4,
    size = 3,
    position = position_jitterdodge(
      dodge.width = 0.7,
      jitter.width = 0.15
    )
  ) +
  
  scale_fill_manual(values = custom_colors,  name = "hepatic_class") +
  scale_color_manual(values = custom_colors, name = "hepatic_class") +
     scale_shape_manual(values = shape_map, name = "Metadata_sex") +
  labs(y = "%", x = NULL) +
  
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, NA),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.025, 0.05))
  ) +
  
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    text = element_text(family = "Arial", size = 16),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.line = element_line(color = "black")
  )
p
#ggsave("../plots/hepatic_class.png", plot = p, width = 7.5, height = 5, dpi = 300,bg = "white")

hepatic_class_grouped <- hepatic_class %>%
  mutate(bar_group = ifelse(hepatic_class == "Non-hepatic", "Non-hepatic", "Hepatic"))

p_stacked_hep <- ggplot(hepatic_class_grouped,
       aes(x = bar_group,
           y = mean_percent,
           fill = factor(hepatic_class))) + 
  geom_col( 
    alpha = 0.85,
    width = 0.5,
    position = position_stack()
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~Metadata_sex) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = custom_colors, name = "Phenotype") +
  
  labs(y = "%", x = NULL) +
  
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 100),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.025, 0.05))
  ) +
  
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    text = element_text(family = "Arial", size = 16),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "right",
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.line = element_line(color = "black")
  )

p_stacked_hep
```
